t: Popopo - Wikipedia
s: October 28, 2025 - Popopo (Korean: 뽀뽀뽀) is a South Korean children's television series broadcast on Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation (MBC). It was a popular children's education program, airing for 32 years with 7,754 episodes. It ran from May 25, 1981 to August 7, 2013. It was one of the leaders in Korean television education for young children, connecting parents and kids with its iconic theme song and promoting a sense of family and community.
